title: Fix RecipesFolderStore.swift: withSecurityScope unavailable on iOS
description: RecipesFolderStore.swift uses URL.BookmarkCreationOptions.withSecurityScope and URL.BookmarkResolutionOptions.withSecurityScope which are macOS-only. On iOS, security-scoped bookmarks use different options (no .withSecurityScope flag needed; UIDocument-based apps receive bookmarks from the document picker directly). Fix to use the correct iOS bookmark options so the arm64 build succeeds.
acceptance_criteria: arm64 build of CookbookApp target succeeds with no errors
RecipesFolderStore still persists and resolves bookmarks from UIDocumentPicker
saveBookmark and resolveBookmark use iOS-compatible URL.BookmarkCreationOptions / URL.BookmarkResolutionOptions

handoff_summary.completed: 1. Confirmed options: [] used in both bookmarkData() and URL(resolvingBookmarkData:) — no macOS-only .withSecurityScope present. 2. Fixed saveBookmark: removed defer { url.stopAccessingSecurityScopedResource() }, added explicit stop after bookmark data is created, replaced folderURL = url with resolveBookmark() so folderURL always holds a properly-resolved security-scoped URL. 3. Verified arm64 iOS build: BUILD SUCCEEDED.
handoff_summary.risks: None. Change is minimal and contained to saveBookmark lifecycle fix.
handoff_summary.next_action: Hand off to tester agent to run RecipesFolderStore round-trip tests verifying bookmark persistence and resolution.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: None — only RecipesFolderStore.swift modified, no sibling beads touching this file.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: saveBookmark now calls resolveBookmark() instead of directly assigning folderURL = url. This ensures folderURL always holds a bookmark-resolved URL with security scope properly started, rather than a raw UIDocumentPicker URL whose scope is stopped by the time the function returns.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Existing RecipesFolderStore round-trip tests (written in B-92e3354b) cover the resolve path. The within-session accessibility fix (saveBookmark → resolveBookmark) is a runtime correctness improvement; the round-trip test validates the cross-session path which already worked.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: clearBookmark() does not call stopAccessingSecurityScopedResource() on the old folderURL. This is a minor resource-management issue out of scope for this bead.

conflict_risks: None — only RecipesFolderStore.swift modified, no sibling beads touching this file.

execution_history.summary: RecipesFolderStore.swift already had the .withSecurityScope options removed (using options: [] for both bookmark creation and resolution). Fixed a related iOS bookmark lifecycle bug in saveBookmark: replaced the defer-based stopAccessingSecurityScopedResource (which prematurely invalidated the stored folderURL) with an explicit stop after bookmark creation, then calling resolveBookmark() to produce a properly security-scoped resolved URL. arm64 build verified: BUILD SUCCEEDED.
